en: Colorized historic view of a European city street and square, with ornate multi‑story buildings in late 19th‑century style, a large sculptural monument in the foreground, terraced stairs lined with trees rising up a hill (the Schlossberg), and horse‑drawn carriages and a bicycle at street level. Printed caption text at the top reads "Karlsbad. Schlossberg", and vertical publisher information appears along the sides.
